event: NEV purchase subsidy rule change: end of 2019 transition period (2019-03-26..06-25); lower central standards apply and local purchase subsidies must stop (财建〔2019〕138号). Effective 2019-06-26.
scope: NEV passenger (BEV/PHEV); local-subsidy stop excludes buses and fuel-cell

event: NEV purchase subsidy extended to end-2022 with cuts of 10%/20%/30% for 2020/2021/2022 (财建〔2020〕86号); 2020 standards apply from 2020-04-23
NEV purchase tax exemption extended 2 years to end-2022 (State Council meeting 2020-03-31; previously due to expire end-2020)
NEV purchase subsidy cut 20% vs 2020 (10% for public/ride-hailing use)
NEV purchase subsidy cut 30% vs 2021 (20% for public/ride-hailing use); schedule first set 2020-04-23, confirmed by 财建〔2021〕466号 on 2021-12-31
Purchase tax halved (10%->5%) for passenger cars <=2.0L and price <=300k yuan excl. VAT, purchases 2022-06-01..2022-12-31 (财政部 税务总局公告2022年第20号)
End of the 2022 small-engine purchase tax halving (back to 10%); end date fixed in the original announcement
National NEV purchase subsidy ends: vehicles registered after 2022-12-31 get no subsidy (end-2022 set 2020-04-23; confirmed 2021-12-31 by 财建〔2021〕466号)
NEV purchase tax exemption extended through 2023-12-31 (财政部 税务总局 工信部公告2022年第27号)

China VI-b emission standard fully implemented nationwide from 2023-07-01 (MEE et al. 公告2023年第14号); light vehicles with RDE 'monitoring only' results may be sold until 2023-12-31. The 07-01 date originally comes from GB18352.6-2016 (not read)
scope: ICE/hybrid light vehicles (non-6b stock clearance before July)

event: NEV purchase tax exemption 2024-2025 continued but capped at 30,000 yuan per passenger car (公告2023年第10号)
scope: NEV passenger (cap bites on high-price NEVs)

event: National car trade-in (scrappage) subsidy: scrap 国三-or-older ICE / pre-2018-04-30 NEV and buy NEV 10,000 yuan, buy ICE <=2.0L 7,000 yuan (汽车以旧换新补贴实施细则, 2024-04-26..2024-12-31)
scope: all passenger (NEV and ICE <=2.0L); scrappage buyers

event: Trade-in scrappage subsidy doubled: NEV 20,000 yuan, ICE <=2.0L 15,000 yuan (applies retroactively from 2024-04-24)
scope: all passenger (NEV and ICE <=2.0L); scrappage buyers

event: 2025 trade-in program continued and widened (国四 ICE cars eligible for scrappage; 20,000 NEV / 15,000 ICE <=2.0L; replacement subsidy also funded) (发改环资〔2025〕13号)
NEV purchase tax goes from exempt to halved (5%), reduction capped at 15,000 yuan per passenger car, 2026-01-01..2027-12-31 (公告2023年第10号)

Stricter 2026-2027 technical requirements for NEV purchase tax reduction: PHEV/EREV equivalent all-electric range >=100 km plus fuel/energy consumption limits; BEV energy consumption limit (工信部 财政部 税务总局公告2025年第24号)
scope: PHEV/EREV (short-range models lose the tax benefit) and BEV

event: 2026 trade-in rules switch to percentage of price: scrappage NEV 12% (max 20,000), ICE <=2.0L 10% (max 15,000); replacement NEV 8% (max 15,000), ICE 6% (max 13,000) (2026年汽车以旧换新补贴实施细则)
scope: all passenger; cheaper cars get less than under the old fixed amounts
